sources.entry: Pangolin - Identity-aware tunneled reverse proxy with dashboard UI, access control, and WireGuard-based tunnels (alternative to Cloudflare Tunnel, Tailscale). (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker
Pangolin | Tunneled reverse proxy with identity and access control, a Cloudflare Tunnel alternative

summary.one_liner: Pangolin is an open-source, WireGuard-based SASE platform combining a tunneled reverse proxy, zero-trust VPN, identity and access control, and an AI gateway, with a self-hostable Community Edition and a managed cloud option.
summary.what_it_does: Pangolin provides lightweight user-space "site" connectors that create outbound tunnels into private networks, so resources behind firewalls can be reached without public IPs or open ports. It offers a browser-based tunneled reverse proxy for HTTPS apps, plus VNC, RDP, and in-browser SSH with privileged access management. Client-based access gives peer-to-peer connectivity to hosts, port ranges, CIDRs, and private HTTPS resources, with DNS aliases. Users come from built-in identities or an external identity provider, and role-based access control grants per-resource rather than per-network access, with audit and access logs. The README also describes an identity-aware AI gateway that proxies cloud and self-hosted model servers with budgets and usage analytics, and a personalized home page for finding accessible resources.
use_cases: expose a self-hosted web app securely without opening ports
replace a Cloudflare Tunnel-style reverse proxy
remote SSH, RDP, or VNC access through a browser
zero-trust access to private networks and databases
single sign-on and role-based access for internal services
gateway for AI model APIs with usage budgets
how_to_run: Sign up for Pangolin Cloud at app.pangolin.net (managed option)
Follow the quick install guide in the documentation at docs.pangolin.net to self-host
Optionally use the DigitalOcean marketplace one-click installer
Deploy a site connector as a binary or container on the target network
notable: Combines zero-trust VPN, reverse proxy, PAM, and AI gateway under one identity and policy model
Site connectors punch outbound tunnels through firewalls with no public IP or open ports
Browser-based VNC, RDP, and SSH without installing a client
Identity-aware AI gateway with keyless access via the desktop client and per-user budgets
Open-core: Community Edition under AGPL-3, Enterprise Edition under a commercial license
caveats: Enterprise Edition features require the Fossorial Commercial License, free only for personal use or businesses under $100K USD gross annual revenue
Some advanced features are limited to the Enterprise Edition
Self-hosting requires setting up a server; the README points to external docs for installation details
